title: Committed project activity
responsibility: Assembles loop usage, recent commits and the latest change to each listed file from caller-provided repository facts.

inputs.name: projectActivity.source
inputs.description: Repository identity and kind, newest-first revisions, callbacks for reasons/changes/owners, loop states and limits for work, files, reasons and units.

outputs.name: projectActivity
outputs.description: Version 1 activity with newest commit or null, loop summaries, bounded work entries and each path once at its latest listed change. Reasons and unit ids are deduplicated; owned files are preferred within a commit.
